Adding a New User
Follow the steps below to create and assign a new user within the dashboard:
1. Access the Dashboard
Open the dashboard of the portfolio to which you want to assign the new user.
2. Navigate to User Management
On the far-left side of the dashboard, locate the User Management button.
Click on this button to access the user management section.
3. Create a New User
In the user management section, find the Create New User option located at the top right
corner of the screen.
Click on Create New User to open the user creation form.

4. Enter User Details
Fill in the required information in the form:
First Name
Last Name
Email Address
Password (create a new password)
Confirm Password
Role (select the appropriate role based on access level)
Active (tick the checkbox to activate the user)
5. Save the User
After entering all the necessary details, click on the Add User button.

6. Confirmation
Once submitted, the new user will be successfully created and visible on the platform.

Create an Alert
Create an Alert from the Dashboard
1. Open the Portfolio where you want to set the alert.
2. From the left-side panel, go to the Alerts section.
3. Click Create New Alert (top-right corner).

4. A dialog box will open.
5. Required Details
Title – Give a name for the alert (e.g., Gateway Status and portfolio name or Sensor Status
Alert and portfolio name).
Type – Select whether the alert is for Gateway or Sensor.
Target – Choose the level where the alert should apply:
Entire Portfolio
Specific Campus
Specific Building
Frequency – Select how often the alert should trigger:
Daily
Weekly
Monthly

Active – Tick the Active checkbox.
6. Click Add Alert to create the alert.
Configure Alert Recipient (Database Step)
7. Open the Database (DB).
8. Open the following tables:
metrics_app_emailalerttrigger

auth_user
Find the Alert Record
9. Open the metrics_app_emailalerttrigger table.
10. Search for the alert using the title you created.
Example query:
title ILIKE 'Gateway Status Westminster'

11. Copy the user_id value from this record.
12. Open the auth_user table.
13. Search for the user using first_name or last_name.
Example query:
first_name ILIKE '%username%'
14. Locate the id column for that user.
15. Replace the id with the user_id value from the metrics_app_emailalerttrigger table.

16. Click Save.
Verify the Alert
17. Return to the Dashboard.
18. Open the Alerts section again.
19. If the alert is no longer visible in the front end, it means the alert has been successfully
configured in the system.
✅ Alert setup is now done
You can use this query to check which portfolios already have sensor or gateway alerts
configured. This helps avoid creating duplicate alerts for the same portfolio.
It will also show you which portfolios currently have alerts set up.
QUERY
select mae.*,au.email from metrics_app_emailalerttrigger mae
join auth_user au on au.id=mae.user_id

Exporting Data from the Dashboard
This guide explains how to export data, reports, and space information from the SmartViz
dashboard.
Accessing the Export Menu
1. Go to the SmartViz Dashboard home page.
2. Select the portfolio you want to work with.
3. From the left-hand navigation panel, click the Map View icon.
4. On the right-hand side of the screen, click the Export button.

5. An export menu will appear with the following export options:
Data
Report
Space Information
Exporting Data
Use this option to download dashboard data in Excel format.
Steps

1. In the export menu, select Data.
2. Choose the building whose data you want to export.
3. Select the required date range from the Date Range section.
4. Choose the preferred data resolution:
Granular data
Aggregated hourly data
5. Select the metrics you want to include in the export, such as:
Occupancy
Booking
Utilisation
Temperature
Booking %
Humidity
6. After configuring all required fields, click Download.

The exported file will be downloaded automatically as an Excel file to your device’s default
download location.
Exporting Reports
Use this option to download dashboard reports for a selected building and time period.
Steps
1. In the export menu, select Report.
2. Choose the required Report Type.

3. Select the building for which you want to generate the report.
4. Select the required date range.
5. Click Download to export the report.
The report file will be downloaded to your device.
Exporting Space Information
Use this option to export information related to spaces within buildings.
Steps
1. In the export menu, select Space Information.

2. Choose the building whose information you want to export.
To export information for a single building, select the building name from the dropdown list.
To export information for all buildings, select the All option.
3. Click Download.
The space information file will be downloaded automatically to your device.
Notes
Exported files are typically downloaded in Excel format.
Available export options and metrics may vary depending on portfolio configuration and user
permissions.
Ensure the required building and date range are selected before downloading the export file.

Sensor Assignment Guide
Client Summary
Overview
This guide explains how to assign sensors to a portfolio using the platform. Sensors can be
assigned individually or in bulk using a CSV upload. Once assigned, the sensors will appear
under the portfolio and can then be mapped to spaces if required.
Assign a Single Sensor
Go to the Devices tab in the portfolio.
Click Assign New Device.
Select Sensors.
Enter the DevEUI (full or last 5 digits).
Click Assign to assign the sensor to the portfolio.
Assign Multiple Sensors (Bulk Upload)
Download the CSV template.
Fill in the Batch name and DevEUI values in the file.
Upload the CSV using Upload Batch.

Download the CSV template.
Fill in the Batch name and DevEUI values in the file.
Upload the CSV using Upload Batch.
After uploading, verify the sensors by searching the DevEUI under Available Devices.
Technical Details Summary
Step 1: Open the portfolio

Step 2: select the Devices tab, the page will look like this.
Step 3: You will see the Assign New Device button.
Step 4: Click on Assign New Device.

Step 5: After clicking, you will see two options:
Sensors
Gateways
Step 6: Select the Sensors option.
Step 7: Enter either the last 5 digits of the DevEUI or the full DevEUI in the bar, then click
Assign. The sensor will be assigned to the portfolio.

Assign Multiple Sensors (Bulk Upload)
Step 8: If you want to assign multiple sensors, click on Download Template.
Step 9: Open the downloaded CSV file. You will see two columns:
Batch
DevEUI
Fill in the Batch column with the portfolio name (or any reference name) and add the DevEUI
numbers in the DevEUI column.

Step 10: Save the file and close it. Then return to the platform.
Step 11: Click on Upload Batch, upload the saved CSV file, and the sensors will be assigned to
the portfolio.
Step 12: Once uploaded, recheck under Available Devices by searching each DevEUI. If the
DevEUIs appear, it confirms that all sensors have been successfully assigned to the portfolio
and the number of available device changed.
